{{recipesummary|Category=salad recipes|servings=8|time=1 hour|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of France|French cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==

* 16 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (loosely packed) [[Cookbook:Frisee|frisee]]
* About ½ cup [[Cookbook:Champagne Vinaigrette|Champagne Vinaigrette]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Goat Cheese Cakes|goat cheese cakes]]
* Crumbled crisp [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]] pieces, for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]]

==Procedure==

# In a large mixing bowl, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] frisee with the Champagne Vinaigrette.
# Divide salad among 8 salad plates.
# Top each salad with a goat cheese cake.
# Garnish with crumbled bacon.
